description: 東串良町 避難場所一覧等 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 東串良町. 東串良町の避難場所等のデータです。 ①災害発生時に安全に避難できる場所 ②避難が長期化する場合の避難所 ③津波の際の一時避難場所（高台） ④ヘリコプターの離着陸場所. Coverage: 東串良町. The portal files it under the publisher 東串良町. Its tags are 災害, 緯度経度, 避難所, 防災. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2020-02-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
